literal_meaning: onomatopoeic sound mimicking stealthy, poised waiting or preparation, like a subtle ticking or rustling in hiding
figurative_meaning_en: being secretly prepared or waiting in hiding for an opportunity
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুরা তক্কেতক্কে অপেক্ষা করছে আক্রমণের জন্য।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm lying in wait, ready to grab the opportunity as soon as it comes.
The enemies are poised in secret, waiting to strike.
note: Variations may reflect regional dialects in Bengali-speaking areas.
